snippet.title: ZX Spectrum Longplay [277] Eliminator (Alternative Software) (EU)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: SCHLAUCHI

From MobyGames:
'Eliminator is a classic horizontal shoot-em-up where the player flies his spaceship over a scrolling, alien landscape. As Group Commander of the United Earth Space Force, J.A. Davidson the player is tasked to take his Skystrike Attack Craft to the vicinity of the Motare Nebulae and find out why several ships have vanished there without a trace.'

Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
